infoYearT1.evidence_source: The data for the present study were drawn from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP), a nationally representative longitudinal study of private households in Germany (Wagner, Frick, & Schupp, 2007). The SOEP was started in 1984, and since then, the same households, persons, and families have been surveyed annually.
